idea-plugin.name: Earl Grey Color Scheme
idea-plugin.description:
A gentle light editor color scheme: an unofficial port of Earl Grey by June Kelly, matched token by token to what the Earl Grey VS Code theme paints for Java.

  • Types and methods in warm gray italics, fields, parameters and locals in slate blue, type parameters in amber.
  • Every Java highlighting key is defined, so no stock IDE colors (purple fields, underlined reassigned variables, olive annotations) leak through.
  • Console colors, diff, search and inlay hint colors from the same palette.
  • Ships colors for the Rainbow Brackets (Lite) plugin; set its number of colors to 6 to get VS Code's bracket pair colors.

Select it in Settings | Editor | Color Scheme. Works best with a light IDE theme.

Earl Grey is licensed under the Parity Public License 7.0.0; source code: earl-grey-theme/earl-grey-vsc.
idea-plugin.change-notes: @VERSION@: first release. Java highlighting verified character by character against VS Code with Red Hat's Java extension.
